newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - April 30.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Wednesday, as reported by Kyodo news agency:
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) eyes revising commercial law to protect stock holders.
-- Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp and other telecommunications companies to consider new cellular phone services.
-- Nissan Motor Co Ltd to strengthen recreational vehicle production.
-- Government subcommittee to study postal service deregulation.
-- Pentagon report cites need to stop North Korean threat.
-- Japan and Australia agree to expand security dialogue.
-- Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto says Japan will not seek to relocate U.S. bases in Japan to Australia.
-- General affairs department of Nomura Securities Co Ltd said it provided special accounts for racketeers.
-- Japan and Australia agree U.S. military presence in Asia-Pacific vital.
-- Citizens seek accountability of local government in bidding process.
